text:
maya (Partnerships): quick heads-up — we're running a contract bakeoff between VaultCo and KeyLattice for the SSO+SCIM+KMS bundle. want to lock vendor for marketplace listing by end of Q2.

sam (Product): scope check — product needs SCIM provisioning, SAML SSO, and BYOK-compatible KMS. also region-specific certs for EU customers.

owen (Eng-Infra): noted. key caveat: KeyLattice's HSM flow is async; could add ~200ms tail in cold-paths. need fallback plan for Dedicated instances.

raj (Security): major gating items for us: HSM attestation, key zeroization docs, and third-party audit (SOC2 type2 + hardware attestation). also need clarity on where metadata for user certs is stored.

lena (Legal): from contracting POV, I'm looking at indemnity around key compromise, export control language, and a carveout for gov data. also want SCIM rate-limit SLA spelled out.

vaultco-biz (Vendor): happy to provide hardware attestation reports and a draft BYOK flow. we can support per-tenant KMS keys and HSM-backed wrapping. demo scheduled next Wed.

maya (Partnerships): thanks — for decision criteria let's capture: security posture (attestation + audits), latency impact, contract terms (indemnity/export), and marketplace packaging (pricing + entitlements).

sam (Product): add integration effort estimate (eng weeks) and support SLAs to that list.

owen (Eng-Infra): quick technical ask for the demo: please include SCIM delta docs and an example SAML metadata bundle. if possible, show an example of fallback to software KMS.

vaultco-biz (Vendor): will include SCIM delta payload and SAML metadata. fallback to soft-KMS is possible but we flag it as lower assurance.

raj (Security): +1 on attestation and I need the HSM vendor chain of custody. also want a short threat-model note: what happens if vendor loses HSM access keys?

lena (Legal): I'll draft vendor redlines. immediate asks: data residency warranty, 30-day key revocation SLA, and a mutual audit clause.

maya (Partnerships): timeline: vendor demos Wed, legal redlines by Fri, security checklist by next Tue. we'll reconvene next Tue afternoon to pick winner.

deploy-bot: demo-room reserved for 2025-06-11 16:00 UTC — link: https://meet.redwood.example/demo/2198765432

sam (Product): tiny sample for SCIM delta we want in demo (paste during call):
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{"op":"replace","path":"emails[primary eq true]","value":"new@example.com"}]
}
```

owen (Eng-Infra): also ask them to show KMS wrap/unwrap latency numbers under 512B payloads. those matter for token signing.

maya (Partnerships): action items: @lena draft redlines, @raj security checklist, @owen integration cost, @sam product criteria scorecard. vaultco to provide demo assets. I'll prep decision matrix template and share before Wed.

raj (Security): I'll include checks for HSM key rotation frequency, attestation refresh cadence, and whether there is a hardware-backed audit log.

lena (Legal): I'll aim to have a short redline summary by EOD Fri.

maya (Partnerships): perfect. if anyone sees blocker items (export controls or extraordinary indemnities) flag here asap. otherwise see you all at the demo. :thumbsup:
